About.title: Crafting <highlight>Flavor</highlight> One Roll at a Time.
About.lead: Gourmet street food, reimagined for the modern foodie in Colombo.
About.imageAlt: Overhead view of a fresh meal, garnishes, and condiments on a wooden table
About.p1: Wrap & Roll was born in the bustling heart of Colombo with a single, uncompromising vision: <bold>Street food deserves a gourmet soul.</bold>
About.p2: We set out to create a menu that bridges the gap between fast-casual convenience and high-end culinary execution. Every wrap is a canvas, and our ingredients are the finest palette we can source. From locally farmed microgreens to house-made tahini-garlic infusions, every detail matters.
About.p3: Our mission is simple: to serve food that makes you feel good, fuels your day, and leaves your palate craving for one more bite.
About.quote: Gourmet at hand, street at heart.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Body: By accessing and ordering from Wrap & Roll, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement.
Terms.section2Body: All orders are subject to availability. Due to the perishable nature of our products, we offer refunds only for unfulfilled or demonstrably erroneous orders.
Terms.section3Body: All content included on this site, such as text, graphics, logos, and images, is the property of Wrap & Roll.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Body: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, place an order, or contact us. This includes your name, phone number, and delivery address.
Privacy.section2Body: We use your information to process transactions, deliver orders, and improve our services.
Privacy.section3Body: Your payment information is securely processed by PayHere. We do not store full credit card details on our servers.
